where: Results Ch. 3 ¶6 ("For starch, the plastid…", PHT4;3), last sentence
why: The 3H adjacency is reported in Results Ch. 2 ¶4 (fiber locus followed 595 kb downstream by the starch locus) and interpreted in Discussion §2 ¶2 ("the two neighbouring loci resolved to two genes, one per trait"), so it is removed from the gene paragraph. Readers can still place both genes, from the gene coordinates here and in Ch. 3 ¶4 and the locus coordinates in Ch. 2 ¶4. "40 kb from its lead SNP, the closest of the three" is not touched here; it belongs to items 4.1 and 6.3 (distances to the lead SNP and the comparisons between genes).
old: The gene lies 40 kb from its lead SNP, the closest of the three, and 1.47 Mb from the acyltransferase above, the two sitting in the fiber and starch loci separated by 595 kb on the long arm of chromosome 3H (Fig. 3b, d).
